text:
I’m a passionate and hard-working machine learning freelancer with 6 years of experience building practical AI solutions in Python. I’ve worked across model development, data preparation, validation, and results interpretation, and I’m comfortable turning raw data into a clear, well-documented pipeline that can be reviewed and reproduced.

For your brain tumor diagnosis project, I can help with the full workflow you described: dataset preparation, train/validation/test splitting, image and mask formatting, model training, evaluation, and documentation. I have hands-on experience with Python, PyTorch, scikit-learn, pandas, machine learning, NLP, XGBoost, Hugging Face Transformers, LangChain, and the OpenAI API, so I’m used to structuring data, training models, and presenting results in a way that is both technically sound and easy to follow.

I understand the importance of documenting the architecture carefully, including layer-wise input-output dimensions, hyperparameters, and the impact of augmentation. I can also help compare model performance with and without augmentation and present the required evaluation metrics and plots such as Accuracy, IoU, Dice Coefficient, Recall, Precision, and F1 score, along with the original image, ground truth, and prediction visuals. I’m also comfortable preparing tables, figures, and concise technical discussion sections that match the structure you outlined.

In a past project, I built a monthly churn score for 380k telecom subscribers with per-customer SHAP reasons the retention team could read. That model achieved an AUC of 0.84 on a held-out quarter and a top-decile lift of 3.1x. That experience strengthened my approach to model evaluation, explainability, and producing results that stakeholders can actually use.

If selected, I’ll focus on clear methodology, careful validation, and polished documentation so the final work is technically strong and presentation-ready. I’d be glad to discuss your dataset files and the exact model requirements so I can align the implementation with your expectations.
